[EN] Those Who Return
[ES] Los que regresan
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Both bears and eclipse thistles are coming back to the forest.
[ES] Tanto los osos como los cardos de eclipse están volviendo al bosque.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Thanks for gathering these.
[ES] Gracias por juntar esto.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "It's an honor to serve."
[ES] "Es un honor servir."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Collect eclipse thistles in the {@Rgn:47002$$Whitefrost Forest} southeast of {@Rgn:77001$$Pathfinder Post}.
[ES] Recoge cardos de eclipse en el {@Rgn:47002$$Bosque de la Escarcha Blanca}, al sureste del {@Rgn:77001$$Puesto del Explorador}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Return to {@Rgn:47006$$Field Base Lunacy} and deliver the eclipse thistles to {@creature:247#1014$$Lenorele}.
[ES] Regresa a la {@Rgn:47006$$Base de operaciones de Lunacy} y entrégale los cardos de eclipse a {@creature:247#1014$$Lenorele}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
